_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiled inside Complacency with no confirmed breaker (funding near flat, rangebound price), so HOLD is the base-rate call until F&G or flows force a rung shift.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst forward is HOLD/Complacency; narrative has no forward phase or direction — agree only on lack of urgent directional impulse
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-54 and BTC stays rangebound with funding near flat and no skew/long unwind
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G leaves 39-62, or funding flips negative with an exchange-inflow spike that breaks price out of the coil
